input_provenance.paper: Target Fishing and Molecular Docking of Terpenes: A Systematic Evaluation of Method Concordance and Ligand Efficiency

source.title: Structure of ar lbd with activator peptide and sarm inhibitor 1

repair.heterogen_policy: Heterogens were excluded from PDBFixer and restored unchanged after protein repair.
repair.policy: Missing atoms and hydrogens were added; unresolved residue segments were recorded but not modeled.

preparation.hydrogen_and_charge_method: PDBFixer hydrogens at pH 7.4; Meeko atom typing and charges
preparation.relaxation: Restrained local OpenMM minimization; parameters and energies are recorded in the repair audit.

interpretation.score_meaning: Vina scores rank predicted poses under this exact preparation protocol.
interpretation.not_an_affinity: Scores are not experimental binding affinity and must not be converted to Ki, Kd, or IC50.
interpretation.comparison_rule: Compare ligands only when receptor, box, protonation, scoring, and search settings are identical.
interpretation.validation: Use known active/inactive controls, redocking RMSD, orthogonal scoring, and experimental binding assays.
